scope.what_this_is: A deterministic, offline benchmark of Genesis's UNDERSTANDING and ROUTING pipeline: does the system classify the request, pick the right level, mode and intent, and select the right capability.
scope.what_this_is_not: NOT evidence of OS execution. benchmark/runner.py drives a _MockOSManager and mocked agents so the run is reproducible and needs no network, API key or real desktop. A passing 'execution' metric means the pipeline routed the operation and the mocked provider accepted it -- not that a file was created, an app was launched or anything outside the test harness happened.
scope.os_operations_executed: none - the OS layer is mocked
scope.external_dependencies: none - no network, no API key
scope.simulated_scenarios: The top-level 'simulated_only' count is scenarios the benchmark itself marks as simulated, which is NOT the same as the whole run being mocked; see os_operations_executed.
